description: Are you a resident of New Mexico District 6 looking to support a congressional candidate who truly cares about the community? Look no further than Paul Spencer for New Mexico District 6!Paul Spencer, a dedicated member of the Republican Party, has a proven track record of community service and advocacy for important issues including fighting for our water rights. His commitment to ensuring that the voices of the community are heard and prioritized sets him apart in the District 6 race. Paul Spen
